how: We read the website of every Houston wedding planner listed on Lazo (136 listings, 93 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: officiants, venues and caterers that also sell coordination, beach-ceremony package crews, a vendor membership group, and planners whose work is mostly abroad. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial, or month-of only? Ask what each tier includes in hours and in meetings.
Which Houston venues have you run a wedding at this year, and what is your weather plan for an outdoor ceremony in July or in hurricane season?
Who is on site on the wedding day, the planner I hired or an associate, and for how many hours?

picks.name: Stewart Weddings
picks.blurb: Stewart Weddings started in 2008 at the encouragement of the founder's husband, and now runs as a three-person team with Helen, who joined after her own wedding in 2016. Several packages are offered, and they will build a custom one if none fits.

picks.name: Épris Events
picks.blurb: Epris Events takes on a limited number of weddings so it can stay devoted to each one, and develops a unique concept for every couple rather than a standard offer. A luxury Houston planner with a nature-inspired approach to design.

picks.name: Fervent Designs, LLC
picks.blurb: Richandra Nickerson-Ukpong is a native Houstonian with over 20 years in events and, in her words, thousands of events and hundreds of weddings planned. Fervent Designs is a one-stop shop: start with planning or wedding management and add products and services from there.

picks.name: Laced with Grace
picks.blurb: Brandi's Laced with Grace Events is selective about how many clients it takes on, and has been in the wedding business for over six years. Planning collections run from vendor recommendations and a timeline up to custom design for every detail. Based in Spring.

picks.name: Agape Wedding Co.
picks.blurb: Sierra Morgan founded Agape Wedding Co. in Katy for fun-loving, down-to-earth, personalization-obsessed couples. Full planning, micro weddings and a day-of or month-of coordination package for couples who already know what they want.

picks.name: Irresistible Events & Services
picks.blurb: Michelle Stack founded Irresistible Events in Katy in 2015 after two and a half decades in event coordination. The pitch is a real hour-by-hour timeline for your day alone, and knowing the vendors, the venue and the plan before the day arrives.

picks.name: Belle Events formerly Belle of the Ball
picks.blurb: Belle Events is a boutique wedding and event firm with offices in Houston and Dallas, planning everything from an intimate event of ten to a bash for a thousand. The team claims more than a century of combined experience.

picks.name: A Day To Remember
picks.blurb: Claudia and her team at A Day To Remember have produced weddings on the Amalfi Coast, in Paris and in Mexico as well as across Texas. Houston-based, with a University of Houston background, and set up to oversee every aspect so the couple stays in the moment.

picks.name: J Low Events
picks.blurb: Jennifer Lowrance's J Low Events is a boutique planning company for weddings, special events and venue consulting in The Woodlands and Houston, with destination work as well.

picks.name: Two Be Wed
picks.blurb: Two Be Wed is a Houston luxury planning and design firm with hundreds of weddings behind it since 2006. Day-of, custom and full planning are all on the menu, and the site states packages start at $2,500.

picks.name: Tevents
picks.blurb: Tatiana Ortiz leads Tevents, an event production company planning weddings and destination weddings in Houston and across Latin America. She brings a business administration background and over 12 years in the industry, and also consults for other planners.

picks.name: Whimsical Creative
picks.blurb: Whimsical Creative is a planner, coordinator and florist in one Houston team, so the design and the flowers come from the same hands. Planning, coordination and floral design are offered separately or together, for a relaxed, high-end feel.
